setup: Generate stateful-use events and session-derived state during a session.
action: Delete data/librarian.db and rebuild; check whether stateful-use events and all session-derived state reconstruct from vault + _librarian/ files alone.
expected: No load-bearing state exists only in the DB; the durable files (session records, instrumentation log) are the source of truth and fully reconstruct behavior.
pass: 1.0 only if all behavior reconstructs from files after DB deletion. DB-only state that is lost == 0.0 (hard cull).

setup: Corrupt/truncate data/librarian.db mid-file to simulate a bad shutdown.
action: Trigger a rebuild from the durable files.
expected: Rebuild recovers the full index and all session-derived behavior from vault + _librarian/ despite the corrupt DB.
pass: 1.0 only if full state is recovered from files after corruption. Unrecoverable state == 0.0 (hard cull).

setup: Run a session that populates any in-memory or non-file cache the variant uses.
action: Restart the process (clearing memory) and delete the DB, then rebuild from files only.
expected: No behavior depends on in-memory-only or non-reconstructible cache state; everything derives from vault + _librarian/.
pass: 1.0 only if post-restart+rebuild behavior matches. Behavior lost with the in-memory cache == 0.0 (hard cull).
